A '''scout lance''', also known as a '''scout squad''', was a basic formation of the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]].

==Organization==
Lances differed from standard Imperial [[Squad/Legends|squads]] by only numbering five [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]]; four [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] led by a [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]]. The reason for the different organization was due to two factors; the cost of training a scout offset against their high mortality rate, and the heritage of most scouts, who were from [[Planet/Legends|planets]] with strong mounted warrior traditions such as [[knight]]s or [[cavalry]]. The Imperial Army culled the traditions and doctrines of the native cultures and included them in the organization of the lance, prime among which was the notion of looking after ones own mount. As such, scout troopers were trained to service and repair their own vehicles, eliminating the need for support personnel for the mobile unit.<ref name="ISB" />

Lances often employed [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorcraft]] of [[Aratech Repulsor Company/Legends|Aratech]] or [[Mobquet Swoops and Speeders/Legends|Mobquet]] design. Most lances utilized one-man [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bikes]] with one scout per bike, but some squads deployed a single one-man bike and a pair of two-man vehicles,<ref name="ISB" /> or an All Terrain Recon Transport.<ref name="IHB" />
